title: Saffy the Little Triceratops and the Rainy Evening Song
description: A peach baby triceratops and a sky-blue baby stegosaurus listen to a gentle rainy evening song in their fern valley, then fall asleep under their favorite tree.

Saffy.color: Warm pastel peach with a creamy-apricot underside and one cream crescent patch on her right cheek
Saffy.bodyShape: Small rounded chubby baby triceratops on four short sturdy legs with a short tapered tail; no clothing or accessories
Saffy.face: Large warm amber-brown eyes, soft muzzle, gentle smile, and a softly scalloped peach frill with five upper scallops
Saffy.accessories: Exactly three short smooth ivory horns: two brow horns and one shorter nose horn

Dewey.color: Soft pastel sky-blue with a powder-blue belly and three pale-blue oval spots on his left hip
Dewey.bodyShape: Small plump baby stegosaurus slightly smaller than Saffy, with four short legs and a gently tapering tail; no clothing
Dewey.face: Large deep teal-blue eyes, soft muzzle, and a gentle smile
Dewey.accessories: Exactly seven rounded periwinkle leaf-shaped back plates in one row, and exactly two tiny rounded pale-blue tail spikes

settingBible.Rainy Dinosaur Valley: A peaceful prehistoric valley with a great sheltering tree, mossy resting hollow, shallow pond, oversized ferns, pale blue flowers, and gentle rain under a moonlit sky
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded baby dinosaurs, golden evening fading to moonlight rain, one scene per page, and no readable text

continuityRules: Saffy stays peach with three ivory horns, a scalloped frill, amber eyes, and a cream crescent on her right cheek.
Dewey stays sky-blue with seven periwinkle plates, two tiny rounded tail spikes, teal eyes, and first appears on page 4.
Dewey remains slightly smaller than Saffy.
Rain stays gentle; no storms, lightning, or frightening weather.
Both end fully asleep under the same great tree.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, text, badge, logo, or readable words.

pages.text: In a quiet valley filled with soft green ferns, a little peach-colored triceratops named Saffy loved listening to the sounds of nature.
pages.illustrationScene: Little peach triceratops Saffy listens to nature in a quiet valley filled with soft green ferns.
pages.continuityNotes: Lock Saffy: pastel peach, three ivory horns, scalloped frill, amber-brown eyes, cream crescent on right cheek. Dewey absent.

pages.text: Every evening, Saffy rested beside a cozy hollow beneath a great old tree, watching the golden sunlight fade behind the distant hills.
pages.illustrationScene: Every evening Saffy rests beside a cozy hollow under a great old tree as golden sunlight fades.
pages.continuityNotes: Saffy alone at great tree hollow; golden sunset.

pages.text: One evening, tiny gray clouds floated across the pink sky, and a gentle breeze whispered through the tall prehistoric grasses.
pages.illustrationScene: Tiny gray clouds float across a pink sky while a gentle breeze whispers through prehistoric grasses.
pages.continuityNotes: Saffy alone; pink sky, small gray clouds, soft breeze.

pages.text: Saffy's best friend, a little sky-blue stegosaurus named Dewey, wandered over and noticed the first sparkling raindrops falling onto the leaves.
pages.illustrationScene: Sky-blue baby stegosaurus Dewey wanders over as the first sparkling raindrops fall onto the leaves.
pages.continuityNotes: Introduce Dewey: sky-blue, seven periwinkle plates, two tiny tail spikes, teal eyes, three hip spots; smaller than Saffy.

pages.text: “Listen, Dewey,” Saffy whispered. “The rain is making a beautiful little song just for us.”
pages.illustrationScene: Saffy whispers to Dewey that the rain is making a beautiful little song just for them.
pages.continuityNotes: Both listening to rain song; gentle, no fear.

pages.text: Soft raindrops tapped against the broad fern leaves, making tiny sounds like gentle fingers playing a wooden drum.
pages.illustrationScene: Soft raindrops tap broad fern leaves like gentle fingers playing a wooden drum.
pages.continuityNotes: Rain on fern leaves; both may be present.

pages.text: Nearby, little drops fell into a shallow pond, creating round ripples that danced beneath the fading evening light.
pages.illustrationScene: Little drops fall into a shallow pond, making round ripples under the fading evening light.

pages.text: Dewey tilted his head and listened as the breeze rustled the treetops, adding a long, sleepy whoosh to the rainy music.
pages.illustrationScene: Dewey tilts his head and listens as the breeze rustles the treetops with a sleepy whoosh.

pages.text: “The whole valley is singing,” Dewey said softly, but the first little stars only peeked between the drifting clouds.
pages.illustrationScene: Dewey says the whole valley is singing as the first little stars peek between drifting clouds.

pages.text: Together, Saffy and Dewey settled beneath the sheltering branches of their favorite tree, watching silvery raindrops sparkle in the moonlight.
pages.illustrationScene: Together Saffy and Dewey settle under their favorite tree watching silvery raindrops sparkle in moonlight.
pages.continuityNotes: Together under sheltering tree; silvery rain in moonlight.

pages.text: The gentle rain grew softer, and the crickets began their quiet evening chirps among the glowing blue flowers.
pages.illustrationScene: The gentle rain grows softer while crickets chirp among glowing blue flowers.
pages.continuityNotes: Rain softens; crickets among blue flowers.

pages.text: “I think the clouds are singing a lullaby,” Saffy murmured, resting her little head on a soft bed of moss.
pages.illustrationScene: Saffy murmurs that the clouds are singing a lullaby, resting her head on soft moss.

pages.text: “Then we should listen with our eyes closed,” Dewey replied sleepily, curling his tail beside his friend.
pages.illustrationScene: Dewey replies sleepily and curls his tail beside Saffy with eyes growing heavy.
pages.continuityNotes: Dewey curls tail beside friend; eyes closing.

pages.text: Beneath the warm shelter of the great tree, Saffy and Dewey snuggled into their leafy resting places while the last raindrops whispered outside.
pages.illustrationScene: Beneath the great tree, Saffy and Dewey snuggle into leafy resting places as last raindrops whisper outside.
pages.continuityNotes: Both in moss-and-leaf beds under tree; last raindrops.

pages.text: As the moon shone over the peaceful dinosaur valley, the two little friends drifted into a deep, happy sleep.
pages.illustrationScene: Under the moon over the peaceful dinosaur valley, Saffy and Dewey sleep side by side with eyes closed.
pages.continuityNotes: Both fully asleep; rain finished; moon and stars; peaceful ending.
